tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open jobs on Ocean of Jobs. Give at least one of query, company, city or country (IL for Israel; most listings are in the US). Returns up to 25 jobs per call, best match first when there is a query, newest first otherwise, with the total number of matches. Every job includes its lifetime (day

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: One job on Ocean of Jobs by its id (from search_jobs or get_company): the description as plain text, its lifetime, whether its data is verified against the employer's ATS, and both links, the Ocean of Jobs page first.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: A company on Ocean of Jobs by name or domain: how many jobs it has open, how many are new this week, how long it has been tracked, its newest jobs, and its Ocean of Jobs page.

tools.name: save_job
tools.description: Save a job to the user's Ocean of Jobs account, where it shows under Saved jobs on every device. Needs the user's personal access token. Saving the same job twice is harmless.

tools.name: list_saved_jobs
tools.description: The jobs saved on the user's Ocean of Jobs account, newest saved first, with the same fields as search results and when each was saved. Needs the user's personal access token.

tools.name: remove_saved_job
tools.description: Take a job off the user's saved list. Needs the user's personal access token.

tools.name: queue_for_auto_apply
tools.description: Queue a job for the Ocean of Jobs Chrome extension to apply to with the user's profile and CV. The extension applies to queued jobs on its next check, every 15 minutes, so the user needs the extension installed and connected. The user must also turn on "Jobs queued by my AI assistant through MCP" in

tools.name: list_auto_apply_queue
tools.description: The jobs waiting in the user's auto apply queue, oldest first, with the same fields as search results and when each was queued. A job leaves the queue once the extension has tried it. Needs the user's personal access token.

tools.name: remove_from_auto_apply_queue
tools.description: Take a job out of the user's auto apply queue before the extension applies to it. Needs the user's personal access token.

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description: The user's job alerts: each one a saved search whose new matches are emailed to them, with its filter and whether it is on. Needs the user's personal access token.

tools.name: create_alert
tools.description: Create a job alert: Ocean of Jobs emails the user new jobs that match the filter, at the times set in their preferences. Up to 5 alerts per account. The email goes to the address the account had when the token was made. Create one only when the user asks for it. Needs the user's personal access toke

tools.name: update_alert
tools.description: Pause or resume a job alert, or replace its filter. A new filter starts from now: jobs already open are not emailed. Needs the user's personal access token.

tools.name: delete_alert
tools.description: Delete a job alert. Its emails stop. Needs the user's personal access token.

tools.name: get_preferences
tools.description: The user's search preferences: their skills, the seniority, workplace and places they want, and when alert emails are sent. The board's best matches and the account overview use them. Needs the user's personal access token.

tools.name: update_preferences
tools.description: Change some of the user's search preferences. Only the fields given change; a list given replaces the old list, so read get_preferences first to add to one. findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "search_jobs" is 1326 chars, far longer than this server's median (175). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_preferences · Private data: save_job, list_saved_jobs, remove_saved_job, queue_for_auto_apply, list_auto_apply_queue, remove_from_auto_apply_queue, list_alerts, create_alert, update_alert, delete_alert, get_preferences, update_preferences · Public sink: create_alert · Destructive: remove_saved_job, remove_from_auto_apply_queue, delete_alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_preferences · Private data: save_job, list_saved_jobs, remove_saved_job, queue_for_auto_apply, list_auto_apply_queue, remove_from_auto_apply_queue, list_alerts, create_alert, update_alert, delete_alert, get_preferences, update_preferences · Public sink: create_alert · Destructive: remove_saved_job, remove_from_auto_apply_queue, delete_alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
